text:
The 2900 ppm/C TC and 0.32 V/V line regulation are large-signal failures, not first-order errors. The small-signal PSRR is about 0.022 V/V, so the core works at nominal. The likely cause is the start-up detector: it is an NMOS gated by vref (about 0.62 V), which sits close to the NMOS Vth. At cold temperature or a VDD shift it turns off, and MS then shorts nb to na. I'm replacing it with a PMOS detector gated by nb, which tracks the core PMOS threshold, and a PMOS kick into na. I'm also nudging VP up to cancel the slope.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "TC 2900 ppm and 0.32 V/V line reg are large-signal breakdowns. Small-signal PSRR is 0.022, so the core is fine. The NMOS detector gated by vref (0.62 V, near Vth) likely drops out cold or at VDD shifts and shorts nb to na. Replace it with a PMOS detector gated by nb that tracks the core PMOS, plus a PMOS kick into na."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":    (0.4e-6, 0.25e-6, 0.6e-6),   # core branch / output current
    "VP":   (0.60, 0.45, 0.75),          # PTAT voltage I*R2 at 27C
    "a":    (0.70, 0.60, 0.90),          # I*R3 (sets divider k)
    "Lp":   (8.0, 3.0, 12.0),            # PMOS mirror length
    "Ln":   (4.0, 1.0, 8.0),             # NMOS beta-multiplier length
    "gmp":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),           # PMOS gm/Id
    "gmn":  (20.0, 14.0, 25.0),          # NMOS gm/Id (weak inversion)
    "Cg":   (2e-12, 0.5e-12, 4e-12),     # PMOS gate-to-vdd cap (PSRR)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = p["I"]; K = 8
    Ln = p["Ln"]
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmn"], Ln, I, vds=0.45)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmn"], Ln, K * I, vds=0.8, vsb=0.08)
    W2 = m2.W
    vg = m1.vgs
    vs = 0.08
    for _ in range(12):
        lo, hi = 0.0, vg
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            idm = lut.op("n", W2, Ln, mid, max(0.85 - vs, 0.1), vs)["Id"]
            if idm > I:
                hi = mid
            else:
                lo = mid
        vgs2 = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        vs_new = max(vg - vgs2, 0.02)
        vs = 0.5 * vs + 0.5 * vs_new
    R1 = vs / I
    R2 = p["VP"] / I
    R3 = p["a"] / I

    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.8)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # beta-multiplier PTAT core
    n.dev("M3", "na", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "nb", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "na", "na", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "nb", "na", "x2", "vss", m2, m=K)
    n.R("R1", "x2", "vss", R1)
    n.C("CG", "nb", "vdd", p["Cg"])
    # output leg: vref = R3/(R2+R3) * (Veb3 + I*R2)
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.R("R3", "vref", "vss", R3)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    n.C("CO", "vref", "vss", 1e-12)
    # start-up: PMOS detector gated by nb (tracks core PMOS Vth).
    # running: MD on -> sx ~ VDD -> MS (PMOS) off. dead: nb=VDD -> MD off, sx held low -> MS injects into na.
    n.M("MD", "sx", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 4.0)
    n.M("MPD1", "sx1", "vdd", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MPD2", "sx", "vss", "sx1", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 20.0)   # off: leakage-level pull-down only
    n.C("CS", "sx", "vss", 200e-15)
    n.M("MS", "na", "sx", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 4.0)

    # predictions
    veb = lambda i: 0.76 + UT * math.log(max(i, 1e-12) / 10e-6)
    iq3 = 0.1 * I; v3 = veb(iq3)
    for _ in range(30):
        iq3 = max((I * R3 - v3) / (R2 + R3), 1e-10); v3 = veb(iq3)
    k = R3 / (R2 + R3)
    vref = k * (v3 + I * R2)
    dveb = (v3 - 1.2) / 300.15 - 3 * UT / 300.15
    slope = k * (dveb + I * R2 / 300.15)
    tc = abs(slope) / vref * 1e6 + 300
    rout = R2 * R3 / (R2 + R3)
    dv = mp.gds * rout * 2.0 + 0.01
    psrr = -db(max(dv, 1e-6))
    power = 1.8 * (3 * I + 0.05e-6)
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": dv,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
```

The new start-up relies on CS holding sx low during the power-up ramp. If MD and MS bias near cutoff at -40 C, there's a small risk the core still sticks. Next iteration's per-temperature results will show that. I also raised VP from 0.55 to 0.60 and lowered a from 0.72 to 0.70 to better cancel the Veb slope.
